user.title: Add an Ollama host
user.description: Point this at an Ollama server. If you skip the scheme, `http://` and port 11434 are assumed, so `desktop.local` works. Reverse-proxied `https://` URLs are fine too.

data_description.name: What to call this host in Home Assistant (e.g. Desktop, Pi). Defaults to something derived from the URL.
data_description.api_key: Only needed if a proxy in front of Ollama wants a Bearer token.
data_description.linked_device: Optional. Pick the computer's existing device (from System Monitor, the companion app, etc.) and these sensors appear there instead of on a separate Ollama device.

reauth_confirm.title: Ollama rejected the credentials
reauth_confirm.description: {name} answered with 401/403. Enter a new API key (or clear it).

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Ollama at that URL. Is it running, and listening beyond localhost (`OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0`)?
error.invalid_auth: The server (or a proxy in front of it) rejected the request with 401/403.
error.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a URL.
error.not_ollama: Something answered, but it doesn't look like Ollama's API.

abort.already_configured: This Ollama host is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask Ollama what's loaded. Installed models and version are refreshed every minute regardless.
data_description.linked_device: Clear it to give this host its own Ollama device again.

load_model.name: Load model
load_model.description: Loads a model into memory on an Ollama host, optionally keeping it there for a while.

device_id.name: Host
device_id.description: Which Ollama host(s). Can be left out if you only have one.

model.name: Model
model.description: Model name as shown by `ollama list`, e.g. qwen3:14b.

keep_alive.name: Keep alive
keep_alive.description: How long to keep it loaded: 5m, 30m, 2h, 24h, forever. Leave empty for the server default.

unload_model.name: Unload model
unload_model.description: Evicts a model from memory right away. Leave the model empty to unload everything.

device_id.name: Host
device_id.description: Which Ollama host(s). Can be left out if you only have one.

model.name: Model
model.description: Model to unload. Empty means all loaded models.

device_not_found.message: Device {device_id} isn't an Ollama Monitor host.

entry_not_loaded.message: Ollama Monitor entry {entry_id} isn't set up or loaded.

no_target.message: You have more than one Ollama host, so pick which one (device_id).

invalid_keep_alive.message: Didn't understand keep_alive "{value}". Try 5m, 1h30m, 3600 or forever.

keep_alive_zero.message: A keep_alive of 0 would unload the model straight away. Use the unload action instead.
